newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Designer Holdings to get $200 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Designer Holdings to get $200 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 16 (LPC) - NationsBank Corp in the next week will seek a group of co-agents for a $200 million senior secured loan for Designer Holdings LTD, banking sources said.
The deal, set to replace a $140 million credit put in place by CIT Group in April 1995, will be launched into general syndication in mid-February, bankers said.

Pricing on the five-year revolver is expected to start at 100 to 125 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, with a 25-37.5 bps commitment fee. The pricing grid is tied to a debt-to-cash flow ratio, bankers said.
NationsBank is soliciting relationship lenders and banks new to the company, they said.
